description: This module allows for the manipulation of GNOME 2 Configuration using gconftool-2. Please see the gconftool-2(1) man pages for more details.

parameters.name: config_source
parameters.description: Specify a configuration source to use rather than the default path.

parameters.name: direct
parameters.description: Access the config database directly, bypassing server. If direct is specified then the config_source must be specified as well. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: A GConf preference key is an element in the GConf repository that corresponds to an application preference.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: The action to take upon the key/value. Choices: "absent" "present"

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Preference keys typically have simple values such as strings, integers, or lists of strings and integers. This is ignored unless state=present.

parameters.name: value_type
parameters.description: The type of value being set. This is ignored unless state=present. Choices: "bool" "float" "int" "string"

examples:
- name: Change the widget font to "Serif 12"
  community.general.gconftool2:
    key: "/desktop/gnome/interface/font_name"
    value_type: "string"
    value: "Serif 12"

return_values.name: key
return_values.description: The key specified in the module parameters. Returned: success Sample: "/desktop/gnome/interface/font_name"

return_values.name: previous_value
return_values.description: The value of the preference key before executing the module. From community.general 7.0.0 onwards it returns null for a non-existent key, and returned "" before that. Returned: success Sample: "Serif 12"

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: The value of the preference key after executing the module or null if key is removed. From community.general 7.0.0 onwards it returns null for a non-existent key, and returned "" before that. Returned: success Sample: "Serif 12"

return_values.name: value_type
return_values.description: The type of the value that was changed. Returned: success Sample: "string"

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Version of gconftool-2. Returned: always Sample: "3.2.6"
